entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My apologies for calling all of you here[n]like this.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Boss was even kind enough to serve us[n]coffee before he went shopping...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now... I have a vital request.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hit me with your best shot! All the tough[n]problems're gonna have to go to[n][fName], though.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hmm, I can help with any subject that's[n]not math.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm? Do you two honestly believe I would[n]ask you here for help in my studies?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The truth is, I am planning to display[n]my work in a competition.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The one organized by Kawanabe of the[n]Japanese Art Support Foundation. You[n]remember, yes, [fName]?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I must win and prove not only my ability,[n]but my intense passion for art as well.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However... I am having quite a bit of[n]trouble determining what my next[n]subject should be.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I have given this painting a fair amount[n]of thought, but nothing has come to me[n]yet.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hence... I was hoping to hear your[n]opinions on an ideal subject.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How 'bout you have Ann strip?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ugh, how long are you gonna keep[n]bringing that up!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, maybe you should paint[n]something people find pretty.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... So in the end, we return to the[n]concept of beauty.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: [fName], what subject do you think[n]would most capture beauty?
Scenery is always nice.
I'd say Morgana.
It has to be Ann.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Indeed... and it is incredibly easy to[n]replicate the allure of a stunning[n]landscape on canvas.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However, a mere photograph would[n]suffice if I were simply hoping to display[n]scenery.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I need something more... Something[n]unique to my own style...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm? You think Morgana is beautiful?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Well, I suppose beauty is in the eye[n]of the beholder.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But honestly... him?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... I suppose she is a subject I put[n]great focus on in the past.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But now I am aware of her true[n]personality... I am not sure I could[n]paint her beautifully...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Haha, that's right!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, what's that supposed to mean!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: *sigh* Why can I not paint a beauty[n]as pure as the "Sayuri"?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Where have all of my efforts gone?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You know, I'm not really sure what[n]you mean by pure beauty.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean yeah, it's a pretty painting.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But... I'm not sure I really consider it[n]a pure beauty or whatever.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I dunno, I guess it just feels more gentle[n]to me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Honestly, I almost cried the first time[n]I saw the "Sayuri."

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It felt kinda like I was a baby again[n]in my mother's arms.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Watching over me, telling me[n]everything's gonna be okay...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That was the gentleness that painting[n]made me feel.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...This is coming from someone with[n]absolutely no art knowledge though!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Gentleness?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That is yet another aspect the "Sayuri"[n]captured that I cannot...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Is my heart too clouded?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It ain't cloudy, dude.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Are you sure about that? Painting used[n]to be all my heart desired... I needed[n]nothing else in life.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But, now? What now!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I have become overwhelmed with[n]a need to prove myself to Kawanabe...[n]to prove myself to the world.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I looked down on Madarame for focusing[n]so sharply on fame and money, yet I too[n]yearn for the praise of others!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In truth, oftentimes I regret declining[n]Kawanabe's offer...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Is this what pure passion is supposed to[n]look like!? My heart is clouded by[n]worldly desires!
What's wrong with that?
The same applies to everyone.
You've really grown, Yusuke.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: How can you say that so casually!?[n]Everything is wrong with it!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No... Have I been looking at it incorrectly[n]this whole time?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, precisely! Everyone in this world is[n]ugly, and I am no different!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Everyone is...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Wait a second... That means... everyone[n]is afflicted with the same ugliness I am?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What? My ugliness has... helped me grow?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: [fName]'s right, dude.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ain't nothing wrong about doin' your[n]best to make a livin'.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And you just want someone to[n]acknowledge your work, right?[n]That's some serious passion.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But... how can passion be born from[n]these repulsive thoughts?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Listen here, dude. I was totally like you[n]back on the track team.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I just wanted to prove myself... to win...[n]to get all the girls to call me shit like[n]"Sakamoto[clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]senpai"...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But y'know, even through all that...[n]I was tryin' to help my team out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sure it's a solo sport, but nobody's[n]gonna run 'til they puke if they don't[n]got teammates they wanna inspire.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess what I really wanna say is, you[n]gotta do stuff for people beyond just[n]yourself if you wanna succeed.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... Is that how it is?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So the sincere gentleness held within[n]the "Sayuri"...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The warmth of its heart...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It was all for the sake of those who gaze[n]upon it?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: How interesting...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, I see!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? Whaddya see!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I have been a fool! Beauty is not the[n]superficial thing I have long thought[n]it to be!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It is something that wells up within[n]the heart until it breaks free!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It is a gift, given by a subject unto[n]its viewer!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, I finally see the truth!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The three of you have my sincerest[n]gratitude! You have been a truly[n]tremendous aid!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: U-Uh...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...How exactly?
We somehow managed to help[n]Yusuke out...
I feel like my bond with Yusuke[n]is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, the time has come for my brush to[n]meet canvas in beautiful harmony!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If you'll excuse me!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, he's actin' even weirder than[n]normal.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He looked pretty inspired though, so[n]he'll be fine... right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, are you guys hungry? I might[n]ask Boss to make me something once[n]he gets back.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hm, maybe curry this time.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: God, you eat so freakin' much...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah, and what was that crap about[n]bein' good at everything 'cept math?[n]It ain't nice to lie, y'know.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wasn't lying! It's just really hard to get[n]good grades at Shujin!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If you're not gettin' good grades, you[n]shoulda known Yusuke wasn't gonna[n]ask you to study with him!
Ann, Ryuji, and I enjoyed[n]the rest of our time together...
It's getting late... I should[n]probably take them to[n]the train station...
